record.bible_text: <FO><FO>A Psalm<WH04210> of David<WH01732>.<Fo><Fo> LORD<WH03068>, I cry<WH07121><WTH8804> unto thee: make haste<WH02363><WTH8798> unto me; give ear<WH0238><WTH8685> unto my voice<WH06963>, when I cry<WH07121><WTH8800> unto thee.

Let my prayer<WH08605> be set forth<WH03559><WTH8735> before<WH06440> thee <FI>as<Fi> incense<WH07004>; <FI>and<Fi> the lifting up<WH04864> of my hands<WH03709> <FI>as<Fi> the evening<WH06153> sacrifice<WH04503>. <RF>set...: Heb. directed<Rf>
Set<WH07896><WTH8798> a watch<WH08108>, O LORD<WH03068>, before my mouth<WH06310>; keep<WH05341><WTH8798> the door<WH01817> of my lips<WH08193>.

Incline<WH05186><WTH8686> not my heart<WH03820> to <FI>any<Fi> evil<WH07451> thing<WH01697>, to practise<WH05953><WTH8705> wicked<WH07562> works<WH05949> with men<WH0376> that work<WH06466><WTH8802> iniquity<WH0205>: and let me not eat<WH03898><WTH8799> of their dainties<WH04516>.<CM>

Let the righteous<WH06662> smite<WH01986><WTH8799> me; <FI>it shall be<Fi> a kindness<WH02617>: and let him reprove<WH03198><WTH8686> me; <FI>it shall be<Fi> an excellent<WH07218> oil<WH08081>, <FI>which<Fi>  shall not break<WH05106><WTH8686> my head<WH07218>: for yet my prayer<WH08605> also <FI>shall be<Fi> in their calamities<WH07451>. <RF>me; it shall be a...: or, me kindly, and reprove me; let not their precious oil break, etc<Rf>
When their judges<WH08199><WTH8802> are overthrown<WH08058><WTH8738> in stony<WH05553> places<WH03027>, they shall hear<WH08085><WTH8804> my words<WH0561>; for they are sweet<WH05276><WTH8804>.
Our bones<WH06106> are scattered<WH06340><WTH8738> at the grave's<WH07585> mouth<WH06310>, as when one cutteth<WH06398><WTH8802> and cleaveth<WH01234><WTH8802> <FI>wood<Fi> upon the earth<WH0776>.

But mine eyes<WH05869> <FI>are<Fi> unto thee, O GOD<WH03069> the Lord<WH0136>: in thee is my trust<WH02620><WTH8804>; leave<WH06168><WH00> not my soul<WH05315> destitute<WH06168><WTH8762>. <RF>leave...: Heb. make not my soul bare<Rf>
Keep<WH08104><WTH8798> me from the snares<WH03027><WH06341> <FI>which<Fi> they have laid<WH03369><WTH8804> for me, and the gins<WH04170> of the workers<WH06466><WTH8802> of iniquity<WH0205>.
Let the wicked<WH07563> fall<WH05307><WTH8799> into their own nets<WH04364>, whilst that I withal<WH03162> escape<WH05674><WTH8799>. <RF>escape: Heb. pass over<Rf><CM>
